registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; powers on at zero (p.1)

commands.name: Load DAC
commands.note: p.15 Figure 24: D15-D0 MSB first on rising CLK; extra leading bits ignored (p.4); loaded into the DAC register (p.14 Table 1: at CS rising)

protocol.note: 16-bit data word only, no control bits; a frame of fewer than 16 bits is invalid (p.15 Figure 25)

pages: p.1 (power-up zero scale), p.4 (pinout, DGK and DRB same numbering), p.5 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.7 (timing, Figure 1: data in on CLK rising), p.14 (Table 1: CS rising loads the DAC register), p.15 (16-bit shift register, CS interrupt)
notModeled: analog: multiplying current output(s), reference input(s), feedback resistor(s)
execution point: p.15 says the word executes at the 16th rising CLK edge, Table 1 (p.14) at CS rising; modeled as the last 16 bits before CS rises (align end)
variants: dac8811.pdf covers only the DAC8811 (B and C grades)
